Ye puzzle MakeMyTrip aur Qualcomm jaise companies ke interview mein poocha gaya hai... aur zyaadatar log isme atak jaate hain! Kya aap solve kar paoge?
Ek band kamra hai. Kamre ke bahar teen switch lage hain, aur andar teen bulb. Har switch, sirf ek bulb se juda hai.
Rule ye hai: switches ko jitni baar chaho, on-off karo. Lekin kamre ka darwaza, sirf ek baar khol sakte ho! Aur bahar se, bulb bilkul nahi dikhte.
Toh batao... kaunsa switch, kaunsa bulb jalata hai? Video ko paanch second rok ke socho, aur apna answer comment mein likho!
Chalo, solution dekhte hain! Sabse pehle, pehla switch on karo, aur das minute ruko... taaki uska bulb garam ho jaye.
Ab pehla switch off karo, doosra switch on karo, aur turant kamre mein jao!
Jo bulb jal raha hai, wo doosre switch ka. Jo bulb bujha hai, par garam hai, wo pehle switch ka! Aur jo bulb bujha bhi hai, aur thanda bhi... wo teesre switch ka!
Trick ye thi, ki bulb sirf roshni nahi, garmi bhi deta hai! Aise hi interview puzzles ke liye, pretestpassed dot codes ko follow karo!
